sources.price: market data: the last close on or before as_of (Yahoo, checked against Alpha Vantage)
sources.risk_free: market data: 10-year Treasury (FRED DGS10) on or before as_of
sources.equity_risk_premium: blank: Damodaran implied ERP from company detail, as for every other company
sources.beta: market data: 60 monthly returns vs the S&P 500 (1.08 on 2026-10-02; Yahoo shows 1.09)
sources.pre_tax_cost_of_debt: interest expense / total debt from the latest TTM filings
sources.pre_tax_cost_of_debt_fallback: 5.8% marginal pre-tax cost of debt (Finbox, yield-based), Oct 2026
sources.shares: latest shares outstanding from the 10-Q (filings), no options (Apple pays stock compensation in RSUs)
sources.revenue_growth: Apple's own case (studies/apple-fy2027): iPhone, Services, Mac, iPad and Wearables each grow at their FY2021-FY2026 CAGR from the 10-Ks (5.8%, 12.5%, 1.5%, -2.6%, -1.5%), fading to 3% over 10 years; the lines add up to this path
sources.cost_pct_revenue: cost of sales follows the mix: products 60.7% and services 23.8% of their sales (FY2026 10-K), so the Services share moving from 25.7% to 34.8% lowers it from 51.2% to 47.9%
